from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialLineItem(BaseModel):
    """A specific financial line item extracted from a single document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The registrant name as stated in the document")
    statement_type: str | None = Field(description="The financial statement name (e.g. 'Consolidated Balance Sheets')")
    line_description: str | None = Field(description="The label or description of the line item")
    period_date: str | None = Field(description="The date of the financial position (e.g., 'December 31, 2023')")
    balance_type: str | None = Field(description="Whether this represents a 'beginning' or 'ending' balance for the period")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value reported in the amount field")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the amount (e.g., 'thousands', 'millions')")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim text excerpt containing the item and value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_line_items: list[FinancialLineItem]
